content:
Overview

Monterrey is a city in Nuevo León with a population of 5,341,171. Mexico’s industrial powerhouse with a modern skyline, top universities, and the highest incomes in the country. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
